ED_Title: High-level meeting to commemorate and promote the International Day against Nuclear Tests
ED_DecisionText: At its 108th plenary meeting, on 31 August 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal its President, decided to invite Robert Floyd, Executive Secretary of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization;   Tina Cordova, Co-Founder of the Tularosa Basin Downwinders Consortium; Magdalene Wangui Wanyaga, Geoscientist, Expert on the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization Verification Regime and Member of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization Scientific Programme Committee; and   Karipbek Kuyukov, Artist, Humanitarian Advocate and a Goodwill Ambassador of Kazakhstan, to make statements at the high-level meeting to commemorate and promote the International Day against Nuclear Tests.
